text_block_list.text:
One day, Air Groove and I were called
to the student council room.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
President, what is it?
I've put on my racing silks as instructed, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry for the suddenness.
The truth is, there's something important I'd like to consult you about.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The next school magazine will feature a special on racing racewear.
Would you be willing to model alongside me for it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Model... together with you...?
But, why me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The reason is... that racing outfit has a very good reputation. Within the academy, that is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"It possesses a unique beauty, elegance, and power—
combining them all into one."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I believed you were the right person to convey what it truly means
to don racing silks, and to inspire those who watch to strive for the same.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To have you say so much... it is an honor.
I will dedicate my whole heart and soul to this endeavor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, how reassuring.
Well then, let us take a photo together—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hold on a sec!!" his

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Teio... Were you hiding in the student council room again?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The one in the photo with Prez is gonna be me!
Me, me, meee! I'm the one standing next to her!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What is it you find so displeasing?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Because, like, if you two take a picture together dressed like that, it's totally gonna look like a wedding photo.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And here I wondered what you were going to say... This is duty.
The President designated me with clear intent.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I have no intention of relinquishing this duty.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm not giving up either!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I think I look way better standing
next to the Prez than Air Groove does~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: They kinda have similar auras, you know? I bet everyone wants to see that too~

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Just listen to yourself...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, I have a good idea. Why don't
Air Groove and Teio take a picture
together instead?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, coming from Teio and myself,
I worry our words might lack persuasive power...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey now! Why does me being with you make it sound less convincing?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Do you really think we have anywhere near as much credibility as the President?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Nothing right now, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmm. If only there were a good idea...
choice_data_list: Let's make the best magazine spread together!
Why don't the three of us take it together instead?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mmhâ¦â¦ Well, if you say results are everything, that's true, butâ¦â¦

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Whatever form it takes,
I will still give it my heart and soul all the same!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Mm. As expected of Air Groove. Dependable as ever.
I'm counting on you with Teio as well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Oooof course! Leave it to me!
I'll make it the absolute best article, so look forward to it~♪
And so, the photoshoot began, but...

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Excuse me... If possible, could you two please match your facial expressions? It would really help us out...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Teio, show a bit more dignity in your expression.
You're making yourself look silly!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove's expression is way too stiff~.
It makes me feel like I'm getting scolded!
Isn't there some good way to get their expressions in sync—something that would make them both smile together...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I heard the photoshoot was running into difficulties...
Is there anything I can do to help?
choice_data_list: ...Wave your hands at the two of them!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: My hand...? Like this?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's the Prez! Yay!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
President...?! 
To think you would come in person—
—The photographer did not miss that moment.

A few days later, the school magazine featuring
the two of them beaming side-by-side was met with great acclaim.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. It might indeed be a good idea
for the Trainer to be in the photo as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"It can express the trust between Umamusume and Trainer,
as well as the full beauty of the racing silks!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so the revisions will affect the text of the academy magazine as well...
I must inform the other party.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's come to this,
there's no stopping the Pre-zident.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
Due to a misunderstanding on Symboli Rudolf's part, I ended up joining the photoshoot.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Alright, taking the picture now—
(*Snap!*)

A few days later, when I checked the sample copy sent
to the student council room...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: With me in the middle, doesn't this kind of look like a family photo...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wh-What are you... That's impossible—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No, depending on how you look at it...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If we leave this, someone might get the wrong idea.
We should collect them—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You think so? The racing outfit, the expression, the composition...
No matter how you look at it, I believe it is a wonderful piece.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: E-Even the President is acting like that...!
And so, the photo shoot for the campus magazine wrapped up with great success.
